name: notes
description: Keep dated notes in your own folder, so later sessions can pick up where earlier ones stopped.

# Notes

Your own folder is shared by all your sessions. It is the working folder
when no repo is attached, and extra folder "home" when one is;
`get_session_workspace` shows its path.

- Keep notes in `notes/` in your folder: one file per day, `notes/YYYY-MM-DD.md`.
- Add to the end of the day's file. Do not rewrite earlier entries.
- Start each entry with the time (UTC) and a one-line topic.
- Before starting a task, read the last two days of notes.
